words: Nick 2026-10-15 on the legs page v2: 'The claws seem to be a little disconnected from the feet themselves. They also look to be a little too present... claws are not one of [this creature's defining features]. So he should have claws because it makes sense, but they shouldn't be these long, noticeable things.' Ruling for Luceras: small, short claws that grow out of the toe tips and read as part of the foot.
